hero.title: File:Arnhem anti tank gun.jpg
hero.artist: Smith (Sgt), No 5 Army Film & Photographic Unit.
hero.credit: This photograph BU 1109 comes from the collections of the Imperial War Museums.
hero.description: A 6-pdr anti-tank gun of No. 26 Anti-Tank Platoon, 1st Border Regiment, 1st Airborne Division at Arnhem, 20 September 1944. The gun was at this moment engaging a German PzKpfw B2 (f) tank, and successfully knocked it out.
